title: 50th BCS written exam schedule published
summary: The written exam for candidates who passed the 50th BCS preliminary starts on 8 December. Compulsory general papers will be held first, followed by cadre-specific technical papers.

title: 50th BCS written: admit card download open
summary: Admit cards for the 50th BCS written examination can be downloaded from the Teletalk BPSC portal using user ID and password.

title: Bangladesh Bank Assistant Director (General) recruitment circular
summary: Bangladesh Bank has invited online applications for the post of Assistant Director (General). Four-year Bachelor or Master degree holders with at least two first divisions/classes may apply.

title: Combined 9 Banks Senior Officer: Preliminary exam date announced
summary: Bankers Selection Committee Secretariat announced the 100-mark preliminary MCQ test for Combined Senior Officer posts across Dhaka centers.

title: 19th NTRCA Teacher Registration examination circular
summary: Applications invited for School, School-2 and College level registration certificates under the 19th Teacher Registration test.

title: Primary Assistant Teacher 3rd phase written MCQ result published
summary: Results of the third-phase MCQ examination published by the Directorate of Primary Education. Viva voce dates will be declared soon.

title: Combined 8 Banks Officer (Cash): 1,511 vacancies circular
summary: Bankers Selection Committee invites applications for 1,511 Officer (Cash) posts in Sonali, Janata, Agrani, Rupali and other banks.
